description: Tasmanian 14.5m Long Controlled Access Buses - Accessible Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. This is the Tasmanian road network that has been assessed for Class 2 and Class 3 Controlled Access Buses, as authorised through the National Class 3 Controlled Access Bus Exemption Notice 2019. The accessibility on the roads and bridges has been divided into 3 categories: Approved, Conditionally Approved and Restricted. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are LAND-Use, TRANSPORTATION-Land. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
